content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD (GPU repo, CPU-side) finite-volume flux/reconstruction file under Simplified BSD header L1-44 (header comment L3 misnames it 'FILE main.F'). SUBROUTINE FLUXES (L52-89) dispatches: HIGH_ORDER(1:3)=='FOU' -> CONSTRUCTION_HO (L67) + WAVE_SPEED (L70), else DelxyFun+CONSTRUCTION+WAVE_SPEED (L74-77); then CONSTR(1:3)=='HLL' -> FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L82) else FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L84); finally BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L87). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L100-111) averages L/R states (P=0.5_SP*(PR+PL) etc, L104-109). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L122-134) applies HLL per variable via 6 calls (L127-132). HLL (L144-167): upwind FL if SL>=0, FR if SR<=0, else HLL flux (L157) divided by (SR-SL), with |SR-SL|<SMALL fallback dividing by SMALL (L158-159). DelxyFun (L177-195) computes van-Leer-limited slopes of Eta,U,V,HU,HV via DelxFun/DelyFun. DelyFun (L205-249)/DelxFun (L259-302): interior van Leer limiter slope (TMP1*ABS(TMP2)+ABS(TMP1)*TMP2)/(ABS(TMP1)+ABS(TMP2)) with SMALL guard -> ZERO, one-sided at boundaries; CARTESIAN scalar DY/DX vs curvilinear DY(I,J)/DX(I,J) preprocessor variants. WAVE_SPEED (L318-405): Zhou et al. 2001 HLL wave-speed bounds SxL/SxR (x, over J=1+Nghost..N-Nghost, I=1+Nghost..M1-Nghost, L335-344) and SyL/SyR (y, L370-379) from SQR_PHI_L/R=SQRT(GRAV*ABS(H)), star values; ghost cells copied by edge extension (L346-367, L382-403). CONSTRUCTION (L418-647): 2nd-order MUSCL via CONSTRUCT_X (5 vars, L439-443) and CONSTRUCT_Y (L545-549); HxL/R=EtaR+Depthx (L444-445); allocatable REAL masks MASK9u/MASK9v built from MASK9 (L428-435); assembles PL/PR (HUxL + Gamma1*MASK9u*HxL*U4xL dispersion correction under CARTESIAN L464-469 or ZALPHA L475-479, plain PL=HUxL else L482-483), FxL/FxR momentum+hydrostatic flux with Gamma3 and 0.5*GRAV*(EtaR^2*Gamma3+2*EtaR*Depth) (L491-518), GxL/GxR cross fluxes (L526-539), and the y-counterparts QL/QR (L567-585), FyL/FyR (L596-608; non-CARTESIAN branch L607-608 multiplies Gamma3 twice), GyL/GyR (L614-641); deallocate L645. U4/V4 slope construction for dispersion only under CARTESIAN (L446-457, L553-563). CONSTRUCT_Y (L660-704)/CONSTRUCT_X (L717-758): piecewise linear reconstruction OutL/OutR = Vin -/+ 0.5_SP*D*Din (Kappa dummy retained but unused per ykchoi comments L674-677, L730-733). CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L774-981): same assembly but reconstruction via CONSTRUCT_HO_X/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L794-798, L888-892; dispersion under CARTESIAN L803-809, L897-903 and ZALPHA L831-837, L923-929). CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod (L995-1098)/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L1113-1217): Yamamoto-type 4th order with minmod-limited Din=TXP2-1/6*(DVP3-2*DVP2+DVP1) (L1064/L1182), wet-dry fallbacks (lower-order L1036-1056, zero-gradient L1058-1062), and OutL/OutR=Vin±1/6*(TXP1+2*TXP2)-type (L1093-1094, L1212-1213); these two _minmod construct routines take DX/DY dummies and are not called in this file. REAL(SP) FUNCTION VANLEER_LIMITER (L1230-1244) and FUNCTION MINMOD_LIMITER (L1246-1260) are defined but only referenced in commented code (L233, L286). CONSTRUCTION_HO (L1274-1466, ENDSUBROUTINE L1466): Erduran et al. (2005) hybrid 4th-order MUSCL-TVD assembly, INTEGER MASK9u/v (L1278), calls CONSTRUCT_HO_X (L1288-1292, U4/V4 L1300-1301 CARTESIAN, L1325-1326 ZALPHA) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1376-1380, L1388-1389, L1414-1415), same PL/Fx/Gx/QL/Fy/Gy formulas (L1305-1460), deallocate L1464. CONSTRUCT_HO_X (L1473-1581)/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1588-1696): 4th-order part with minmod triple limiter into Din (L1542/L1657), 3rd-order part with van Leer ratio limiter VAN1/VAN2=(RAT+ABS(RAT))/(1+RAT) guarded by SMALL (L1550-1576, L1665-1691). No file I/O; data blocks: none (source code).

verbatim_spans.text: ! YUAN following declaration should be wiped out
! ghost cells, this does not really matter
! there was a HUGE bug here, 12 should versus 43, fixed. fyshi
!   08/31/21016  fyshi changed the subroutine name HO_vanleer to HO

unresolved: L607-608 (CONSTRUCTION, non-CARTESIAN branch): FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL*Gamma3 and FyR likewise multiply Gamma3 twice, unlike GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL*Gamma3 (L538) and CONSTRUCTION_HO's FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL (L1459) -- apparent Gamma3^2 bug; relation L538 vs L607 vs L1459.

CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L774), CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod (L995) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L1113) are never called in this file (FLUXES L67 calls CONSTRUCTION_HO; CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod itself calls CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y without the DX/DY dummies the _minmod variants require); kept per comments L61-65 and L990-992.

VANLEER_LIMITER (L1230) and MINMOD_LIMITER (L1246) are defined but every use is commented out (L216, L233, L270, L286); VANLEER_LIMITER one-arg branch (A+ABS(A))/(1.0+A) (L1240) has no guard against A=-1.

CONSTRUCTION ZALPHA branch (L473-479, L502-512, L575-581, L625-635) uses U4xL/V4yL and MASK9u/v, but the DelxFun/CONSTRUCT_X construction of U4/V4 (L446-457, L553-563) is compiled only under CARTESIAN -- in a non-CARTESIAN+ZALPHA build these arrays are used without being built in this subroutine (CONSTRUCTION_HO/minmod by contrast have ZALPHA construct calls L831-837, L1322-1328).

TMP1/TMP2 (DelyFun L222-234, DelxFun L276-287, CONSTRUCT_HO_X L1548-1576, CONSTRUCT_HO_Y L1663-1691) and loop indices I,J (e.g. HLL L150-151, DelyFun L219-220) are not declared locally despite IMPLICIT NONE -- they must be module variables from USE PARAM; not resolvable from this file.
HLL fallback (L158-159): when |SR-SL|<SMALL the numerator is divided by SMALL instead of the actual denominator, scaling the flux arbitrarily rather than limiting it; relation L157-L161.
File header comment L3 says 'FILE main.F' although this file is fluxes.F.
Kappa dummy of CONSTRUCT_X/CONSTRUCT_Y (L660, L717) is declared (L670, L727) but unused after Choi's 2016 rewrite (comments L674-677, L730-733); callers still pass Kappa (L439-443, L545-549).
WAVE_SPEED x-interface ghost fill loops L346-367 and y-interface L382-403 are labeled 'does not really matter' (L346); comment block L309-315 records the Dmitry M1/N1 dimension bug history.
